messages:
Priya S: Quick PR ping — ready for merge but need cross-team eyes (runtime + infra + security) before canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/61234

Ben: Skimmed, left one nit about metric name in the diff. No blockers otherwise.

Olivia: @Priya S I can run the perf harness vs main. ETA ~2h. what's a good canary window?

Priya S: Planning 10% traffic, 60m window tomorrow 10:00 PST. Config below:
```yaml
canary:
  percent: 10
  window: 60m
```

runtime-bot: CI build passed — bench run shows +0.2% p50 latency (small bump in kv lookup path)

Sam: I'll take infra/security check, one Q — did you add KMS key rotation test or a mock? @Priya S

Priya S: Added a unit test that mocks KMS and an integration test flagged as optional, linked in PR.

Marta: I'll eyeball authz/header ordering. Suggest capping canary to 5% if runtime latency is >1% vs baseline. :eyes:

Priya S: OK noted. If runtime perf is within 1% we'll keep 10%, otherwise move to 5% and extend window. Thanks all — ping me here when you have LGTM and I'll schedule merge.
